description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
longDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.
name: Acid Armor
shortDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 2.

description: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
name: Acid Spray
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.

description: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.
name: Acrobatics
shortDescription: Power doubles if the user has no held item.

description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.
name: Aerial Ace
shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy.

description: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
longDescription: The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.
name: After You
shortDescription: The target makes its move right after the user.

description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.
longDescription: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.
name: Agility
shortDescription: Raises the user's Speed by 2.

description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Air Cutter
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio. Hits adjacent foes.

description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Air Slash
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.
name: Alluring Voice
shortDescription: 100% confuse target that had a stat rise this turn.

description: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
longDescription: The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.
name: Ally Switch
shortDescription: User and ally swap positions; using again can fail.

description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Raises the user's Special Defense by 2 stages.
name: Amnesia
shortDescription: Raises the user's Sp. Def by 2.

description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
name: Ancient Power
shortDescription: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).

description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Aqua Jet
shortDescription: Usually goes first.

description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
longDescription: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.
name: Aqua Ring
shortDescription: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn.

description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.
name: Aqua Tail
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.
longDescription: Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.
name: Assurance
shortDescription: Power doubles if target was damaged this turn.

description: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Astonish
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.
longDescription: Causes the target to become infatuated, making it unable to attack 50% of the time. Fails if both the user and the target are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated. The effect ends when either the user or the target is no longer active. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
name: Attract
shortDescription: A target of the opposite gender gets infatuated.

description: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.
name: Aura Sphere
shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy.

description: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Aurora Beam
shortDescription: 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

description: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only when it is snowing.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.
name: Aurora Veil
shortDescription: For 5 turns, damage to allies halved. Snow only.

description: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.
longDescription: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.
name: Avalanche
shortDescription: Power doubles if user is damaged by the target.

description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Baby-Doll Eyes
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Attack by 1.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: This move summons Reflect for 5 turns upon use.
name: Baddy Bad
shortDescription: Summons Reflect.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.
name: Barrier
shortDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 2.

description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.
longDescription: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Dragon Cheer, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected.
name: Baton Pass
shortDescription: User switches, passing stat changes and more.

description: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.
longDescription: Hits one time for the user and one time for each unfainted Pokemon without a non-volatile status condition in the user's party. The power of each hit is equal to 5+(X/10), where X is each participating Pokemon's base Attack; each hit is considered to come from the user.
name: Beat Up
shortDescription: All healthy allies aid in damaging the target.

description: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.
name: Belly Drum
shortDescription: User loses 50% max HP. Maximizes Attack.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: The target receives the user's held item. Fails if the user has no item or is holding a Z-Crystal, if the target is already holding an item, if the item is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it, or if the item is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, or Memory and either the user or the target is a Kyogre, Groudon, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, or Silvally, respectively.
name: Bestow
shortDescription: User passes its held item to the target.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: The user spends two turns locked into this move and then, on the second turn after using this move, the user attacks the last Pokemon that hit it, inflicting double the damage in HP it lost to attacks during the two turns. If the last Pokemon that hit it is no longer active, the user attacks a random opposing Pokemon instead. If the user is prevented from moving during this move's use, the effect ends. This move does not check accuracy and does not ignore type immunity.
name: Bide
shortDescription: Waits 2 turns; deals double the damage taken.

description: A long body, tentacles, or the like are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
longDescription: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
name: Bind
shortDescription: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Bite
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
name: Blast Burn
shortDescription: User cannot move next turn.

description: The user launches a kick that has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This may also leave the target with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Blaze Kick
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to burn.

description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.
name: Blizzard
shortDescription: 10% chance to freeze foe(s). Can't miss in Snow.

description: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.
longDescription: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
name: Block
shortDescription: Prevents the target from switching out.

description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
longDescription: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.
name: Body Press
shortDescription: Uses user's Def stat as Atk in damage calculation.

description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
name: Body Slam
shortDescription: 30% chance to paralyze the target.

description: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits two to five times in a row.
longDescription: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
name: Bone Rush
shortDescription: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
name: Bouncy Bubble
shortDescription: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Breaking Swipe
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Attack by 1.

description: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
longDescription: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.
name: Brick Break
shortDescription: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.

description: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.
longDescription: Power doubles if the target has less than or equal to half of its maximum HP remaining.
name: Brine
shortDescription: Power doubles if the target's HP is 50% or less.

description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Brutal Swing
shortDescription: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Bubble Beam
shortDescription: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
name: Bulk Up
shortDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Bulldoze
shortDescription: 100% chance lower adjacent Pkmn Speed by 1.

description: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Bullet Punch
shortDescription: Usually goes first.

description: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
longDescription: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
name: Bullet Seed
shortDescription: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

description: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to burn the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.
name: Burning Jealousy
shortDescription: 100% burns a target that had a stat rise this turn.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the foe.
name: Buzzy Buzz
shortDescription: 100% chance to paralyze the foe.

description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
longDescription: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Calm Mind
shortDescription: Raises the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 1.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages. The target is unaffected if both the user and the target are the same gender, or if either is genderless. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability are immune.
name: Captivate
shortDescription: Lowers the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 2 if opposite gender.

description: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!
name: Celebrate
shortDescription: No competitive use.

description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Raises the user's Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's next Electric-type attack will have its power doubled; the effect ends when the user is no longer active, or after the user attempts to use any Electric-type move besides Charge, even if it is not successful.
name: Charge
shortDescription: +1 SpD, user's next Electric move 2× power.

description: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Has a 70% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
name: Charge Beam
shortDescription: 70% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.
name: Charm
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Attack by 2.

description: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Chilling Water
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

description: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
longDescription: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target is under the effect of Ingrain, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
name: Circle Throw
shortDescription: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

description: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.
name: Clear Smog
shortDescription: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

description: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Close Combat
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.
longDescription: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
name: Coaching
shortDescription: Raises an ally's Attack and Defense by 1.

description: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
name: Confide
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.
longDescription: Causes the target to become confused.
name: Confuse Ray
shortDescription: Confuses the target.

description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.
name: Confusion
shortDescription: 10% chance to confuse the target.

description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
longDescription: The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Dynamax Cannon, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.
name: Copycat
shortDescription: Uses the last move used in the battle.

description: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.
longDescription: The target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
name: Corrosive Gas
shortDescription: Removes adjacent Pokemon's held items.

description: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.
longDescription: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.
name: Counter
shortDescription: If hit by physical attack, returns double damage.

description: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.
longDescription: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
name: Covet
shortDescription: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.

description: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Cross Chop
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio.

description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
name: Crunch
shortDescription: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

description: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.
longDescription: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.
name: Curse
shortDescription: Curses if Ghost, else -1 Spe, +1 Atk, +1 Def.

description: The target is cut with a scythe or claw.
name: Cut
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Dark Pulse
shortDescription: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Dazzling Gleam
shortDescription: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

description: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.
longDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage. As long as the user remains active, the power of the user's Ice Ball and Rollout will be doubled (this effect is not stackable).
name: Defense Curl
shortDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 1.

description: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.
longDescription: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. If this move is successful and whether or not the target's evasiveness was affected, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side. Ignores a target's substitute, although a substitute will still block the lowering of evasiveness. If there is a terrain active and this move is successful, the terrain will be cleared.
name: Defog
shortDescription: -1 evasion; ends user and target hazards/terrain.

description: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
longDescription: Until the user's next move, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that Pokemon faints as well, unless the attack was Doom Desire or Future Sight. Fails if the user used this move successfully as its last move, disregarding moves used through the Dancer Ability.
name: Destiny Bond
shortDescription: If an opponent knocks out the user, it also faints.

description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
longDescription: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
name: Detect
shortDescription: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
longDescription: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Earthquake and Magnitude but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
name: Dig
shortDescription: Digs underground turn 1, strikes turn 2.

description: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.
longDescription: For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.
name: Disable
shortDescription: For 4 turns, disables the target's last move used.

description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
longDescription: This move does not check accuracy.
name: Disarming Voice
shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy. Hits foes.

description: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
name: Discharge
shortDescription: 30% chance to paralyze adjacent Pokemon.

description: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.
longDescription: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Surf and Whirlpool but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
name: Dive
shortDescription: Dives underwater turn 1, strikes turn 2.

description: The user attacks by kicking the target twice in a row using two feet.
longDescription: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
name: Double Kick
shortDescription: Hits 2 times in one turn.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.
name: Double Slap
shortDescription: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.
longDescription: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.
name: Double Team
shortDescription: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1.

description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.
longDescription: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Double-Edge
shortDescription: Has 33% recoil.

description: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
name: Draco Meteor
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
name: Dragon Breath
shortDescription: 30% chance to paralyze the target.

description: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.
longDescription: Raises the target's chance for a critical hit by 1 stage, or by 2 stages if the target is Dragon type. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user, or if the target already has this effect or the Focus Energy effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.
name: Dragon Cheer
shortDescription: Ally: Crit ratio +1, or +2 if ally is Dragon type.

description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.
name: Dragon Claw
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage.
name: Dragon Dance
shortDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1.

description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.
name: Dragon Pulse
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
name: Dragon Rage
shortDescription: Deals 40 HP of damage to the target.

description: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
name: Dragon Rush
shortDescription: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
longDescription: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
name: Dragon Tail
shortDescription: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

description: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
longDescription: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
name: Drain Punch
shortDescription: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

description: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.
longDescription: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
name: Draining Kiss
shortDescription: User recovers 75% of the damage dealt.

description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
longDescription: The target is unaffected by this move unless it is asleep. The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
name: Dream Eater
shortDescription: User gains 1/2 HP inflicted. Sleeping target only.

description: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.
longDescription: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
name: Dual Chop
shortDescription: Hits 2 times in one turn.

description: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
longDescription: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
name: Dual Wingbeat
shortDescription: Hits 2 times in one turn.

description: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.
name: Dynamic Punch
shortDescription: 100% chance to confuse the target.

description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Earth Power
shortDescription: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
longDescription: Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.
name: Earthquake
shortDescription: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dig.

description: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, its power is boosted.
longDescription: For every consecutive turn that this move is used by at least one Pokemon, this move's power is multiplied by the number of turns to pass, but not more than 5.
name: Echoed Voice
shortDescription: Power increases when used on consecutive turns.

description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.
name: Eerie Impulse
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 2.

description: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain. During the effect, the power of Electric-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot fall asleep; Pokemon already asleep do not wake up. Grounded Pokemon cannot become affected by Yawn or fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into an Electric type, Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause paralysis. Fails if the current terrain is Electric Terrain.
name: Electric Terrain
shortDescription: 5 turns. Grounded: +Electric power, can't sleep.

description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.
name: Electro Ball
shortDescription: More power the faster the user is than the target.

description: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Electroweb
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the target's held item has no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by the target. Items thrown at the target with Fling will still activate for it. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to use items.
name: Embargo
shortDescription: For 5 turns, the target's item has no effect.

description: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
name: Ember
shortDescription: 10% chance to burn the target.

description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.
longDescription: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.
name: Encore
shortDescription: Target repeats its last move for its next 3 turns.

description: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.
name: Endeavor
shortDescription: Lowers the target's HP to the user's HP.

description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.
longDescription: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
name: Endure
shortDescription: User survives attacks this turn with at least 1 HP.

description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Energy Ball
shortDescription: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

description: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.
longDescription: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.
name: Expanding Force
shortDescription: User on Psychic Terrain: 1.5× power, hits foes.

description: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
longDescription: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
name: Explosion
shortDescription: Hits adjacent Pokemon. The user faints.

description: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Extreme Speed
shortDescription: Nearly always goes first.

name: Fairy Wind
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
name: Fake Out
shortDescription: Hits first. First turn out only. 100% flinch chance.

longDescription: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

shortDescription: Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 2.

If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.
name: Feint
shortDescription: Nullifies Detect, Protect, and Quick/Wide Guard.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
name: Feint Attack
shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy.

shortDescription: Does damage equal to the user's HP. User faints.

longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
name: Fire Fang
shortDescription: 10% chance to burn. 10% chance to flinch.

description: A column of fire hits the target. When used with its grass counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a vast sea of fire appears.
longDescription: If one of the user's allies chose to use Grass Pledge or Water Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Fire Pledge with 150 power and a sea of fire appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which causes damage to non-Fire types equal to 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect, including the last turn. If combined with Water Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Fire Gem.
name: Fire Pledge
shortDescription: Use with Grass or Water Pledge for added effect.

description: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

longDescription: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
name: Fire Spin
shortDescription: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
name: Fissure
shortDescription: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.

description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
name: Flail
shortDescription: More power the less HP the user has left.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the target's ally loses 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, unless it has the Magic Guard Ability.
name: Flame Burst
shortDescription: Damages Pokemon next to the target as well.

description: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

shortDescription: Has 33% recoil. 10% chance to burn. Thaws user.

longDescription: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Flash Cannon
shortDescription: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

If there is no target or the target avoids this move by protecting itself, the user's held item is still lost. The user can regain a thrown item with Recycle or the Harvest Ability. Fails if the user has no held item, if the held item cannot be thrown, if the user is under the effect of Embargo or Magic Room, or if the user has the Klutz Ability.
name: Fling
shortDescription: Flings the user's item at the target. Power varies.

description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
longDescription: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
name: Flip Turn
shortDescription: User switches out after damaging the target.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Floaty Fall
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
longDescription: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
name: Fly
shortDescription: Flies up on first turn, then strikes the next turn.

name: Focus Energy
shortDescription: Raises the user's critical hit ratio by 2.

longDescription: The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move.
name: Focus Punch
shortDescription: Fails if the user takes damage before it hits.

description: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.
longDescription: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.
name: Follow Me
shortDescription: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.

description: The target is attacked with a shock wave. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
name: Force Palm
shortDescription: 30% chance to paralyze the target.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Ghost type. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Miracle Eye or Odor Sleuth.
name: Foresight
shortDescription: Fighting, Normal hit Ghost. Evasiveness ignored.

description: The user turns the target's strength against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage this move inflicts.
longDescription: Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.
name: Foul Play
shortDescription: Uses target's Attack stat in damage calculation.

description: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. This move's type effectiveness against Water is changed to be super effective no matter what this move's type is.
name: Freeze-Dry
shortDescription: 10% chance to freeze. Super effective on Water.

longDescription: Resets the stat stages of all active Pokemon to 0.
name: Freezy Frost
shortDescription: Eliminates all stat changes.

description: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
name: Frenzy Plant
shortDescription: User cannot move next turn.

description: The user attacks by blowing its cold breath on the target. This move always lands a critical hit.
longDescription: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
name: Frost Breath
shortDescription: Always results in a critical hit.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Power is equal to the greater of ((255 - user's Happiness) × 2/5), rounded down, or 1.
name: Frustration
shortDescription: Max 102 power at minimum Happiness.

description: The user attacks by slashing the target with scythes, claws, or the like. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.
longDescription: Power doubles with each successful hit, up to a maximum of 160 power. The power is reset if this move misses or another move is used.
name: Fury Cutter

If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
name: Fury Swipes
shortDescription: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

longDescription: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.
name: Future Sight
shortDescription: Hits two turns after being used.

description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
longDescription: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

name: Giga Impact
shortDescription: User cannot move next turn.

longDescription: This move summons Light Screen for 5 turns upon use.
name: Glitzy Glow
shortDescription: Summons Light Screen.

description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.

name: Grass Pledge

name: Grassy Glide
shortDescription: User on Grassy Terrain: +1 priority.
