name: Grassy Terrain
shortDescription: 5 turns. Grounded: +Grass power, +1/16 max HP.

description: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the evasiveness of all active Pokemon is multiplied by 0.6. At the time of use, Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, and Telekinesis end immediately for all active Pokemon. During the effect, Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash, and Telekinesis are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. Ground-type attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability can affect Flying types or Pokemon with the Levitate Ability. Fails if this move is already in effect.
name: Gravity
shortDescription: 5 turns: no Ground immunities, 1.67× accuracy.

description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Growl
shortDescription: Lowers the foe(s) Attack by 1.

description: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If the weather is Sun or Intense Sun, this move raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella, this move will only raise the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage, even if the weather is Sun or Intense Sun.
name: Growth
shortDescription: Raises user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; 2 in Sun.

description: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.
longDescription: Until the user's next turn, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that move loses all its remaining PP.
name: Grudge
shortDescription: If the user faints, the attack used loses all its PP.

description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
longDescription: The user swaps its Defense and Special Defense stat stage changes with the target.
name: Guard Swap
shortDescription: Swaps Defense and Sp. Def changes with target.

description: A vicious tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
name: Guillotine
shortDescription: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.

description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
name: Gunk Shot
shortDescription: 30% chance to poison the target.

description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Hail. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are an Ice type or have the Ice Body, Magic Guard, Overcoat, or Snow Cloak Abilities. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Hail.
name: Hail
shortDescription: For 5 turns, hail crashes down.

description: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
name: Happy Hour
shortDescription: No competitive use.

description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
longDescription: Resets the stat stages of all active Pokemon to 0.
name: Haze
shortDescription: Eliminates all stat changes.

description: The user attacks the target with a hazardous full-power headbutt. This also damages the user terribly.
longDescription: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Head Smash
shortDescription: Has 1/2 recoil.

description: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Headbutt
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Headlong Rush
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.
longDescription: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Soundproof Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.
name: Heal Bell
shortDescription: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.

description: The user emits a healing pulse that restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP.
longDescription: The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user has the Mega Launcher Ability, the target instead restores 3/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.
name: Heal Pulse
shortDescription: Heals the target by 50% of its max HP.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Heart Stamp
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user slams into the target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
name: Heat Crash
shortDescription: More power the heavier the user than the target.

description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
name: Heat Wave
shortDescription: 10% chance to burn the foe(s).

description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
name: Heavy Slam
shortDescription: More power the heavier the user than the target.

description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.
longDescription: The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.
name: Helping Hand
shortDescription: One adjacent ally's move power is 1.5× this turn.

description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.
longDescription: Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.
name: Hex
shortDescription: Power doubles if the target has a status ailment.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: This move's type depends on the user's individual values (IVs), and can be any type but Fairy and Normal.
name: Hidden Power
shortDescription: Varies in type based on the user's IVs.

description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
name: High Horsepower
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
longDescription: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.
name: High Jump Kick
shortDescription: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.

description: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.
longDescription: No competitive use. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
name: Hold Hands
shortDescription: No competitive use.

description: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.
longDescription: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1 stage.
name: Hone Claws
shortDescription: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1.

description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
name: Horn Attack
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
name: Horn Drill
shortDescription: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.

description: The user drains the target's energy with its horns. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
longDescription: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
name: Horn Leech
shortDescription: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

description: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.
longDescription: Raises the Attack of the user and all allies 1 stage.
name: Howl
shortDescription: Raises the user's and ally's Attack by 1.

description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This may also confuse the target.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
name: Hurricane
shortDescription: 30% chance to confuse target. Can't miss in rain.

description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
name: Hydro Pump
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.
longDescription: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
name: Hyper Beam
shortDescription: User cannot move next turn.

description: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Hyper Voice
shortDescription: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.
name: Hypnosis
shortDescription: Causes the target to fall asleep.

description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.
name: Ice Beam
shortDescription: 10% chance to freeze the target.

description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
name: Ice Fang
shortDescription: 10% chance to freeze. 10% chance to flinch.

description: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This may also leave the target frozen.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.
name: Ice Punch
shortDescription: 10% chance to freeze the target.

description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Ice Shard
shortDescription: Usually goes first.

description: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.
longDescription: Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.
name: Ice Spinner
shortDescription: Ends the effects of terrain.

description: The user attacks by crashing large icicles onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Icicle Crash
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The user attacks by launching sharp icicles at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
longDescription: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
name: Icicle Spear
shortDescription: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Icy Wind
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.

description: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.
longDescription: The user prevents all opposing Pokemon from using any moves that the user also knows as long as the user remains active.
name: Imprison
shortDescription: No foe can use any move known by the user.

description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.
longDescription: The target loses its held item if it is a Berry or a Gem. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
name: Incinerate
shortDescription: Destroys the foe(s) Berry/Gem.

description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to burn the target.
name: Inferno
shortDescription: 100% chance to burn the target.

description: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.
longDescription: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
name: Infestation
shortDescription: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

description: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it can't switch out.
longDescription: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP restored at the end of each turn, but it is prevented from switching out and other Pokemon cannot force the user to switch out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped and still receive the healing effect. During the effect, the user can be hit normally by Ground-type attacks and be affected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web, even if the user is a Flying type or has the Levitate Ability.
name: Ingrain
shortDescription: Traps/grounds user; heals 1/16 max HP per turn.

description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
longDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.
name: Iron Defense
shortDescription: Raises the user's Defense by 2.

description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
name: Iron Head
shortDescription: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
name: Iron Tail
shortDescription: 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

description: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. If the user is an Ogerpon, this move's type changes depending on its form. Water type for Wellspring Mask, Fire type for Hearthflame Mask, and Rock type for Cornerstone Mask.
name: Ivy Cudgel
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio. Type depends on user's form.

description: The user slaps down the target's held item, making it unusable for that battle. This move does more damage if the target has a held item.
longDescription: This move's power is multiplied by 1.5 if the target is holding an item, and the target loses its held item if the user has not fainted. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. This move does not increase in power or remove the target's item if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
name: Knock Off
shortDescription: 1.5× damage if foe holds an item. Removes item.

description: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.
name: Kowtow Cleave
shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy.

description: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
longDescription: Until the end of the next turn, the user's attacks will be critical hits.
name: Laser Focus
shortDescription: Until the end of the next turn, user's moves crit.

description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.
longDescription: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.
name: Lash Out
shortDescription: 2× power if the user had a stat lowered this turn.

description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
longDescription: This move fails unless the user knows this move and at least one other move, and has used all the other moves it knows at least once each since it became active or Transformed.
name: Last Resort
shortDescription: Fails unless each known move has been used.

description: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.
name: Lava Plume
shortDescription: 30% chance to burn adjacent Pokemon.

description: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and cuts the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Leaf Blade
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio.

description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
name: Leaf Storm
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

description: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
longDescription: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
name: Leech Life
shortDescription: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.
longDescription: The Pokemon at the user's position steals 1/8 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. If Big Root is held by the recipient, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue being leeched. If the target switches out or uses Mortal Spin or Rapid Spin successfully, the effect ends. Grass-type Pokemon are immune to this move on use, but not its effect.
name: Leech Seed
shortDescription: 1/8 of target's HP is restored to user every turn.

description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage.
name: Leer
shortDescription: Lowers the foe(s) Defense by 1.

description: The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
name: Lick
shortDescription: 30% chance to paralyze the target.

description: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
longDescription: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
name: Life Dew
shortDescription: Heals the user and its allies by 1/4 their max HP.

description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from special attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
name: Light Screen
shortDescription: For 5 turns, special damage to allies is halved.

description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
name: Liquidation
shortDescription: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
longDescription: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.
name: Low Kick
shortDescription: More power the heavier the target.

description: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Low Sweep
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot be struck by a critical hit. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
name: Lucky Chant
shortDescription: For 5 turns, shields user's party from critical hits.

description: Moves like Leech Seed and moves that inflict status conditions are blocked by a barrier and reflected back to the user of those moves.
longDescription: Until the end of the turn, the user is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this move takes effect.
name: Magic Coat
shortDescription: Bounces back certain non-damaging moves.

description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the held items of all active Pokemon have no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
name: Magic Room
shortDescription: For 5 turns, all held items have no effect.

description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.
name: Magical Leaf
shortDescription: This move does not check accuracy.

description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the user is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will gain the effect. Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball override this move if the user is under any of their effects. Fails if the user is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.
name: Magnet Rise
shortDescription: For 5 turns, the user has immunity to Ground.

description: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
name: Make It Rain
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 1. Hits foe(s).

description: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
longDescription: Has a 50% chance to badly poison the target.
name: Malignant Chain
shortDescription: 50% chance to badly poison the target.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: The user uses the move the target chose for use this turn against it, if possible, with its power multiplied by 1.5. The move must be a damaging move other than Beak Blast, Belch, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Comeuppance, Counter, Covet, Focus Punch, Magical Torque, Me First, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, Noxious Torque, Shell Trap, Struggle, Thief, or Wicked Torque. Fails if the target moves before the user. Ignores the target's substitute for the purpose of copying the move.
name: Me First
shortDescription: Copies a foe at 1.5× power. User must be faster.

description: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
longDescription: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
name: Mean Look
shortDescription: Prevents the target from switching out.

description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
longDescription: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
name: Mega Drain
shortDescription: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.
name: Mega Kick
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
name: Mega Punch
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
name: Megahorn
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user faints. In return, the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. The user faints unless this move misses or there is no target. Fails entirely if this move hits a substitute, but does not fail if the target's stats cannot be changed.
name: Memento
shortDescription: Lowers target's Attack, Sp. Atk by 2. User faints.

description: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
longDescription: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.
name: Metal Burst
shortDescription: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5× damage.

description: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Metal Claw
shortDescription: 10% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
name: Metal Sound
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 2.

description: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This may also boost the user’s Attack stat.
longDescription: Has a 20% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Meteor Mash
shortDescription: 20% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
longDescription: A random move is selected for use, other than After You, Apple Acid, Armor Cannon, Assist, Astral Barrage, Aura Wheel, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Body Press, Branch Poke, Breaking Swipe, Celebrate, Chatter, Chilling Water, Chilly Reception, Clangorous Soul, Collision Course, Combat Torque, Comeuppance, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Crafty Shield, Decorate, Destiny Bond, Detect, Diamond Storm, Doodle, Double Iron Bash, Double Shock, Dragon Ascent, Dragon Energy, Drum Beating, Dynamax Cannon, Electro Drift, Endure, Eternabeam, False Surrender, Feint, Fiery Wrath, Fillet Away, Fleur Cannon, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Freeze Shock, Freezing Glare, Glacial Lance, Grav Apple, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, Hyper Drill, Hyperspace Fury, Hyperspace Hole, Ice Burn, Instruct, Jet Punch, Jungle Healing, King's Shield, Life Dew, Light of Ruin, Magical Torque, Make It Rain, Mat Block, Me First, Meteor Assault, Metronome, Mimic, Mind Blown, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Moongeist Beam, Nature Power, Nature's Madness, Noxious Torque, Obstruct, Order Up, Origin Pulse, Overdrive, Photon Geyser, Plasma Fists, Population Bomb, Pounce, Power Shift, Precipice Blades, Protect, Pyro Ball, Quash, Quick Guard, Rage Fist, Rage Powder, Raging Bull, Raging Fury, Relic Song, Revival Blessing, Ruination, Salt Cure, Secret Sword, Shed Tail, Shell Trap, Silk Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snap Trap, Snarl, Snatch, Snore, Snowscape, Spectral Thief, Spicy Extract, Spiky Shield, Spirit Break, Spotlight, Springtide Storm, Steam Eruption, Steel Beam, Strange Steam, Struggle, Sunsteel Strike, Surging Strikes, Switcheroo, Techno Blast, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Thousand Arrows, Thousand Waves, Thunder Cage, Thunderous Kick, Tidy Up, Trailblaze, Transform, Trick, Twin Beam, V-create, Wicked Blow, Wicked Torque, or Wide Guard.
name: Metronome
shortDescription: Picks a random move.

description: The user copies the move last used by the target. The copied move can be used until the user of Mimic leaves the battle.
longDescription: While the user remains active, this move is replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, if the user already knows the move, or if the move is Assist, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Hold Hands, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Tera Starstorm, Transform, or Wicked Torque.
name: Mimic
shortDescription: The last move the target used replaces this one.

description: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.
longDescription: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field. Fails if this effect is active for the user.
name: Mind Reader
shortDescription: User's next move will not miss the target.

description: A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.
longDescription: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a special attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's special attack this turn.
name: Mirror Coat
shortDescription: If hit by special attack, returns double damage.

description: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the user and its party members are protected from having their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
name: Mist
shortDescription: For 5 turns, protects user's party from stat drops.

description: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.
longDescription: If the current terrain is Misty Terrain and the user is grounded, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5. The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
name: Misty Explosion
shortDescription: User faints. User on Misty Terrain: 1.5× power.

description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Misty Terrain. During the effect, the power of Dragon-type attacks used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5 and grounded Pokemon cannot be inflicted with a non-volatile status condition nor confusion. Grounded Pokemon can become affected by Yawn but cannot fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into a Fairy type, Nature Power becomes Moonblast, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower Special Attack by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Misty Terrain.
name: Misty Terrain
shortDescription: 5 turns. Can't status,-Dragon power vs grounded.

description: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
name: Moonblast
shortDescription: 30% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
longDescription: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Strong Winds or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
name: Moonlight
shortDescription: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
longDescription: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Strong Winds or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
name: Morning Sun
shortDescription: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Mud Shot
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
name: Mud-Slap
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
name: Muddy Water
shortDescription: 30% chance to lower the foe(s) accuracy by 1.

description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
name: Mystical Fire
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Raises the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
name: Nasty Plot
shortDescription: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: The type and power of this move depend on the user's held Berry, and the Berry is lost. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry, if the user has the Klutz Ability, or if Embargo or Magic Room is in effect for the user.
name: Natural Gift
shortDescription: Power and type depends on the user's Berry.

description: This attack makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.
longDescription: This move calls another move for use based on the battle terrain. Tri Attack on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, Thunderbolt during Electric Terrain, Moonblast during Misty Terrain, Energy Ball during Grassy Terrain, and Psychic during Psychic Terrain.
name: Nature Power
shortDescription: Attack depends on terrain (default Tri Attack).

description: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.
name: Night Shade
shortDescription: Does damage equal to the user's level.

description: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Night Slash
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Causes the target to lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn as long as it is asleep. This move does not affect the target unless it is asleep. The effect ends when the target wakes up, even if it falls asleep again in the same turn.
name: Nightmare
shortDescription: A sleeping target is hurt by 1/4 max HP per turn.

description: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.
name: Nuzzle
shortDescription: 100% chance to paralyze the target.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
name: Ominous Wind
shortDescription: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).

description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
longDescription: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
name: Outrage
shortDescription: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

description: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
longDescription: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
name: Overheat
shortDescription: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.
longDescription: The user and the target's HP become the average of their current HP, rounded down, but not more than the maximum HP of either one.
name: Pain Split
shortDescription: Shares HP of user and target equally.

description: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If this move is successful, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if the target's Attack and Special Attack stat stages were both unchanged, or if there are no unfainted party members.
name: Parting Shot
shortDescription: Lowers target's Atk, Sp. Atk by 1. User switches.

description: Coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Pay Day
shortDescription: Scatters coins.

description: The user stores power, then attacks. This move's power is doubled if the user moves after the target.
longDescription: Power doubles if the user moves after the target this turn, including actions taken through Instruct or the Dancer Ability. Switching in does not count as an action.
name: Payback
shortDescription: Power doubles if the user moves after the target.

description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
longDescription: Each active Pokemon receives a perish count of 4 if it doesn't already have a perish count. At the end of each turn including the turn used, the perish count of all active Pokemon lowers by 1 and Pokemon faint if the number reaches 0. The perish count is removed from Pokemon that switch out. If a Pokemon uses Baton Pass while it has a perish count, the replacement will gain the perish count and continue to count down.
name: Perish Song
shortDescription: All active Pokemon will faint in 3 turns.

description: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Petal Blizzard
shortDescription: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

description: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
longDescription: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
name: Petal Dance
shortDescription: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

description: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
longDescription: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
name: Phantom Force
shortDescription: Disappears turn 1. Hits turn 2. Breaks protection.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness × 2/5), rounded down, or 1.
name: Pika Papow
shortDescription: Max happiness: 102 power. Can't miss.

description: The user attacks by shooting sharp spikes at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
longDescription: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
name: Pin Missile
shortDescription: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

description: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target's Attack stat.
longDescription: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Play Nice
shortDescription: Lowers the target's Attack by 1.

description: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Play Rough
shortDescription: 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

description: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the faces of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.
longDescription: Poisons the target.
name: Poison Gas
shortDescription: Poisons the foe(s).

description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.
longDescription: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
name: Poison Jab
shortDescription: 30% chance to poison the target.

description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.
longDescription: Poisons the target.
name: Poison Powder
shortDescription: Poisons the target.

description: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.
name: Poltergeist
shortDescription: Fails if the target has no held item.

description: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Pounce
shortDescription: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.
name: Power Gem
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
longDescription: The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.
name: Power Swap
shortDescription: Swaps Attack and Sp. Atk stat stages with target.

description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.
name: Power Whip
shortDescription: No additional effect.

description: Striking opponents over and over makes the user’s fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.
longDescription: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.
name: Power-Up Punch
shortDescription: 100% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.

description: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. The gift restores HP sometimes, however.
longDescription: If this move is successful, it deals damage or heals the target. 40% chance for 40 power, 30% chance for 80 power, 10% chance for 120 power, and 20% chance to heal the target by 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.
name: Present
shortDescription: 40, 80, 120 power, or heals target 1/4 max HP.

description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
longDescription: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
name: Protect
shortDescription: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.
name: Psybeam
shortDescription: 10% chance to confuse the target.

description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
longDescription: The user copies all of the target's current stat stage changes.
name: Psych Up
shortDescription: Copies the target's current stat stages.

description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
longDescription: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
name: Psychic
shortDescription: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

description: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
longDescription: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.
name: Psychic Fangs
shortDescription: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.

description: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
longDescription: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.
name: Psychic Noise
shortDescription: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from healing.

description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Psychic-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot be hit by moves with priority greater than 0, unless the target is an ally. Camouflage transforms the user into a Psychic type, Nature Power becomes Psychic, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Psychic Terrain.
name: Psychic Terrain
shortDescription: 5 turns. Grounded: +Psychic power, priority-safe.

description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Psycho Cut
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio.

description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.
name: Psyshock
shortDescription: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Deals damage to the target equal to (user's level) × (X + 50) / 100, where X is a random number from 0 to 100, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
name: Psywave
shortDescription: Random damage equal to 0.5×-1.5× user's level.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: If an opposing Pokemon switches out this turn, this move hits that Pokemon before it leaves the field, even if it was not the original target. If the user moves after an opponent using Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch, but not Baton Pass, it will hit that opponent before it leaves the field. Power doubles and no accuracy check is done if the user hits an opponent switching out, and the user's turn is over; if an opponent faints from this, the replacement Pokemon does not become active until the end of the turn.
name: Pursuit
shortDescription: If a foe is switching out, hits it at 2× power.

description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
longDescription: No additional effect.
name: Quick Attack
shortDescription: Usually goes first.

description: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
longDescription: The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
name: Quick Guard
shortDescription: Protects allies from priority attacks this turn.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Once this move is successfully used, the user's Attack is raised by 1 stage every time it is hit by another Pokemon's attack as long as this move is chosen for use.
name: Rage
shortDescription: Raises the user's Attack by 1 if hit during use.

description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain.
name: Rain Dance
shortDescription: For 5 turns, heavy rain powers Water moves.

description: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
longDescription: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
name: Rapid Spin
shortDescription: Free user from hazards/bind/Leech Seed; +1 Spe.

description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.
name: Razor Leaf
shortDescription: High critical hit ratio. Hits adjacent foes.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
name: Razor Wind
shortDescription: Charges, then hits foe(s) turn 2. High crit ratio.

description: The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.
longDescription: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
name: Recover
shortDescription: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.
longDescription: The user regains the item it last used. Fails if the user is holding an item, if the user has not held an item, if the item was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by a Pokemon with the Pickup Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.
name: Recycle
shortDescription: Restores the item the user last used.

description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.
longDescription: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from physical attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
name: Reflect
shortDescription: For 5 turns, physical damage to allies is halved.

description: The user reflects the target's type to become the same type as the target.
longDescription: Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.
name: Reflect Type
shortDescription: User becomes the same type as the target.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: The user cures its burn, poison, or paralysis. Fails if the user is not burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.
name: Refresh
shortDescription: User cures its burn, poison, or paralysis.

description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.
longDescription: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.
name: Rest
shortDescription: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.

description: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move's power is boosted if an ally fainted in the previous turn.
longDescription: Power doubles if one of the user's party members fainted last turn.
name: Retaliate
shortDescription: Power doubles if an ally fainted last turn.

description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
longDescription: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness × 2/5), rounded down, or 1.
name: Return
shortDescription: Max 102 power at maximum Happiness.

description: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.
longDescription: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.
name: Revenge
shortDescription: Power doubles if user is damaged by the target.

description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
longDescription: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
name: Reversal
shortDescription: More power the less HP the user has left.

description: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.
longDescription: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain and the target is grounded, this move's power is doubled.
name: Rising Voltage
shortDescription: 2× power if target is grounded in Electric Terrain.

description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
